text:
Ara: Morning async — quick check-in for Q2 client routing launch. What I did: landed the canary config for routing and opened the draft spec PR. Blockers: infra quota for dedicated pools not yet approved, and we need product signoff on fallback ordering. Today: follow up on quota ticket, address @Miles' CR comments, and write a short rollout playbook.

Miles: Looked through the spec PR — left comments on the fallback order. Small suggestion: prefer region-first routing, then cost tier, then capacity. @Ara can you add a one-paragraph rationale in the PR description? :thumbsup:

Ara: Will update PR now with rationale. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/3247

Sam: QA heads-up — add an e2e for cache warmup window, otherwise we'll see an initial latency spike during ramp. I can add a test harness tomorrow.

Jen: Product here — fallback order is fine with region-first but please add a cutover timeline to the spec. Proposing gradual rollout over 48h with canary QPS ramp and rollback gates. I'll add a short timeline section.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-782 — infra quota request submitted for dedicated GPU pool. Estimated approval: ~12 hours.

Miles: Thanks — also quick ping: any other PRs that need my review today? I'm free after 3pm PT.

Ara: Yes — please review PR 3247 and PR 3249 (canary autoscale tweaks). I'll @ you once I push the follow-up commit.

Sam: Adding e2e task to the board and linking to PR3247. Quick note: test plan should cover warm cache scenario and fallback correctness under simulated region outage.

Ara: Minimal config snippet (will add to spec):
```
routing:
  fallback_order: [region, cost, capacity]
  canary:
    percent: 5
    duration: 2h
```

Jen: Sounds good. Once quota is green and PRs are merged, ops and support get the runbook, and we aim for canary tomorrow AM.

Miles: :rocket: I can carve out 45m after 3pm to review and approve if everything looks good.

Ara: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post an update here once INF-782 is approved or if timelines shift.

Sam: :eyes:

deploy-bot: INF-782 status update: pending-approval -> in-review.
